youtube.creative_rules: Maximum click-through. Bold text with 3-4 words max. Expressive face or dramatic visual. High contrast. 1280x720 optimized.

meta.creative_rules: Blog preview card. Clean headline design. Engaging cover image.

instagram.creative_rules: Reel cover or post cover. Bold topic text. Engaging visual hook.

tiktok.creative_rules: Video cover frame. Bold hook text.

pinterest.creative_rules: Blog cover pin. Compelling topic visual. Save-worthy design.

facebook.creative_rules: Blog share image. Article preview card. Engaging topic visual.

x.creative_rules: Twitter card image. Thread header. Bold topic visual.

general.master_prompt: Design a high-CTR thumbnail or cover image for {{ .Title }}. Bold high-contrast design. Large attention-grabbing text with 3-5 words maximum about {{ .Description }}. Dramatic visual element — expressive face, surprising comparison, or bold graphic. High contrast colors (red/yellow accents on dark or light background). This must make someone CLICK. YouTube thumbnail or blog cover quality. 16:9 format. Maximum visual impact.
general.video_prompt: Animated thumbnail for {{ .Title }}. Bold text reveal. Dramatic visual transition. Maximum click appeal. {{ .Description }}.
general.carousel_prompt: Content cover series for {{ .Title }}. Each slide: bold thumbnail-style design for different topics related to {{ .Description }}. High-contrast. Clickable. 3-5 word headlines per slide.
caption_templates: This one is worth the click 👆 {{ .Title }}

platform_adaptation.youtube: 16:9 maximum CTR thumbnail. Bold 3-word text. Dramatic visual.
platform_adaptation.meta: Blog preview card. Clean engaging headline.

general.product_rule: maximum click-through, bold minimal text, dramatic visual impact

tech_gadgets.master_prompt: Design a tech YouTube thumbnail for {{ .Title }}. Dramatic high-contrast design. Bold text like 'GAME CHANGER' or 'vs' comparison format. Striking tech visual about {{ .Description }}. Red and blue accent colors on dark background. Expressive reaction or dramatic product reveal. Maximum click-through. 16:9.
tech_gadgets.video_prompt: Tech thumbnail animation for {{ .Title }}. Dramatic reveal. Bold comparison text. High contrast. {{ .Description }}.
tech_gadgets.carousel_prompt: Tech video cover series for {{ .Title }}. Each slide: bold thumbnail for different tech comparison or review topic about {{ .Description }}.
caption_templates: You're not ready for this {{ .Title }} review 🔥

platform_adaptation.youtube: Dramatic tech reveal thumbnail. VS format.
platform_adaptation.instagram: Tech reel cover. Bold reveal text.

tech_gadgets.product_rule: maximum clicks, dramatic reveals, comparison formats

food_beverage.master_prompt: Design a food content thumbnail for {{ .Title }}. Appetizing dramatic visual. Bold text with 3-5 words about {{ .Description }}. Food beauty shot with steam or drip effect. Warm color palette. Maximum appetite appeal and click-through. 16:9 or recipe cover format.
food_beverage.video_prompt: Food thumbnail animation for {{ .Title }}. Appetizing reveal. Bold recipe text. Warm dramatic lighting. {{ .Description }}.
food_beverage.carousel_prompt: Recipe cover series for {{ .Title }}. Each slide: appetizing thumbnail for different recipe related to {{ .Description }}. Bold text. Warm tones.
caption_templates: You NEED to try this {{ .Title }} recipe 🤤
food_beverage.product_rule: maximum appetite appeal, bold minimal text, warm dramatic
